name: Overwhelm [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You know how to lead others to overwhelm large foes with sheer numbers.

Benefit(s): Your allies are considered to be flanking an opponent if you are threatening that opponent and the opponent is at least two size categories larger than the larger of you or your ally, regardless of your actual positioning.

Normal: You must be positioned opposite an ally to flank an opponent.

Special: Animal companions may take this feat if it knows the Flank Trick.
